summary: Expose explicitly declared agent lifecycle metadata to a client without inferring a default.

replay.detail: No full claim replay or projection migration is required. Existing agent declarations without lifecycle metadata remain unknown. Declaration replacements update or clear the roster value.

schema.detail: No database schema or index change. Agent declarations gain optional lifecycle metadata with standing, owner, or bounded. Client-v0 roster rows gain an optional lifecycle field modeled as an open response enum so clients retain future values as Unknown.

rules.detail: Lifecycle metadata does not change runtime state, process behavior, restart policy, or ownership rules. Omission supplies no default and does not infer a value from other settings.

compatibility.detail: Agent KDL accepts the optional lifecycle child with standing, owner, or bounded. A client receives the selected declaration's value; the roster field is omitted when absent. An unfamiliar future string decodes as Unknown without dropping the row. A client must treat an omitted field, including from an older server, as undeclared.

manual.detail: No existing declaration needs modification. Publish lifecycle metadata only when its value is known; omit the child in a replacement declaration to clear it.

recovery.detail: No new recovery procedure. Existing declarations without the optional metadata preserve their behavior.

downtime.detail: Normal daemon restart for upgrade; interruption duration has not been measured.
